_: A plague that walks the roads (contagion.js; Banished's and Frostpunk's sickness, Plague Inc's spread along routes, CK3's epidemics with their choices). It begins in a town Freeciv makes sick (its own illness) or, with chance start a season, in the realm's biggest town in summer. Each season it may pass from every sick town whose roads are open to each town it trades with (trade.js routes) by spread; a town is sick for lasts seasons, and while sick it is plague in the realm's eyes (view.js: households die harder, minds fear, moods), its fields half worked (the Blight decree, blight seasons). The King's answers come as event cards (cards, events.js's shape, subject sick_town, when.contagion: a plague is abroad, spread: at least that many towns): close: its roads shut (no carts, no spread out; the town suffers), heal: physicians shorten its sickness by heal seasons, burn: every sick town's sickness ends next season.

cards.subject: sick_town
cards.title: Sickness in {town}
cards.text: The death-carts go out at night in {town}. The reeve asks what the crown will do before it walks the roads to the next town.

choices.label: Close the roads to {town}
text: Spearmen stand on every road out of {town}. No cart leaves, and nobody brings bread in.

choices.label: Send the King's physicians (60 gold)
text: The King's physicians ride into {town} with vinegar and herbs, and some of them come out again.

choices.label: Pray, and let the roads stay open
text: Bells ring for {town} in every chapel. The carts keep moving, and so does the sickness.

ignore.text: No word comes from the crown. {town} buries its dead and the carts keep moving.

cards.subject: sick_town
cards.title: The sickness is in many towns
cards.text: {town} is one of many now. The physicians say fire is the only cure: burn the houses of the dead, bedding and all.

choices.label: Burn the houses of the dead
text: Smoke stands over every sick town. The sickness is burnt out, and so is half the poor quarter.

choices.label: Let it run its course
text: The crown waits. The sickness does not.

ignore.text: The crown says nothing, and the sickness walks on.
